org: Central European University (CEU)

name.ar: الجامعة الصيفية في CEU لعام 2027 (بودابست/فيينا)

deadline_note: CEU: 2027 course list published end of November/early December 2026. In 2026 the deadline was 1 March for scholarship and visa applicants and 15 April for self-funded; 2027 dates expected to follow the same pattern (confirm on each course page).

summary.en: Short research-intensive summer courses in social sciences, humanities, law and public policy at Central European University, mainly for master's and PhD students and young professionals. Need-based tuition waivers and travel/accommodation scholarships are available.
summary.ka: მოკლე, კვლევაზე ორიენტირებული საზაფხულო კურსები სოციალურ მეცნიერებებში, ჰუმანიტარულ დისციპლინებში, სამართალსა და საჯარო პოლიტიკაში Central European University-ში, ძირითადად მაგისტრანტების, დოქტორანტებისა და ახალგაზრდა პროფესიონალებისთვის. ხელმისაწვდომია საჭიროებაზე დაფუძნებული გადასახადის შეღავათები და მგზავრობისა და საცხოვრებლის სტიპენდიები.
summary.ar: دورات صيفية قصيرة ومكثفة بحثياً في العلوم الاجتماعية والإنسانيات والقانون والسياسات العامة في جامعة أوروبا الوسطى، أساساً لطلاب الماجستير والدكتوراه والمهنيين الشباب. تتوفر إعفاءات من الرسوم ومنح للسفر والإقامة حسب الحاجة.

about.en:
CEU Summer University (SUN) has run for 30 years and offers one- and two-week advanced courses taught by international faculty on topics such as democracy and citizenship, human rights, Roma studies, higher-education policy, history and philosophy. Participants come from dozens of countries, many from Central and Eastern Europe, the Caucasus and Central Asia.

Tuition in 2026 was around EUR 500–650 per course, but SUN is not-for-profit and offers a flexible, need-based system of partial and full tuition waivers plus scholarships towards travel and accommodation; these must be requested at the application stage with strong justification.

en: Advanced courses with international faculty and a very diverse cohort
Full and partial tuition waivers plus travel/accommodation grants
Strong fit for students from the Caucasus and Central/Eastern Europe

eligibility.en: Mainly master's and PhD students, junior faculty and professionals in relevant fields; some courses accept advanced undergraduates. Check each course's eligibility. Good English required. Open to all nationalities.

en: Browse the 2027 courses (published around early December 2026)
Pick a course and check its specific requirements
Apply online with CV, motivation and any course-specific documents
Request a tuition waiver/scholarship in the application if needed (deadline 1 March in 2026)
Self-funded applicants without visa needs had until 15 April in 2026

costs.en: Tuition roughly EUR 500–650 per course (2026). Need-based full/partial tuition waivers and scholarships for travel and accommodation available.

score_reason: Affordable, scholarship-backed academic summer school popular in the region.

org: Korea University

name.ar: الحرم الصيفي الدولي في جامعة كوريا (ISC) 2027

deadline_note: 2026 cycle: applications 19 Jan – 15 May 2026; classes 29 June – 24 July (4-week) / 6 Aug (6-week). 2027 dates not yet published; estimated from that pattern.

summary.en: A four- or six-week credit-bearing summer programme in Seoul with university courses in English, Korean language and cultural activities, open to students from any university.
summary.ka: ოთხ- ან ექვსკვირიანი კრედიტიანი საზაფხულო პროგრამა სეულში ინგლისურენოვანი საუნივერსიტეტო კურსებით, კორეული ენით და კულტურული აქტივობებით, ნებისმიერი უნივერსიტეტის სტუდენტებისთვის.
summary.ar: برنامج صيفي معتمد لمدة أربعة أو ستة أسابيع في سيول يضم مواد جامعية بالإنجليزية واللغة الكورية وأنشطة ثقافية، مفتوح لطلاب أي جامعة.

about.en:
Korea University's International Summer Campus (ISC) is one of Asia's largest summer schools. Students take credit-bearing courses taught in English by faculty from KU and universities worldwide (business, economics, international relations, Korean studies, engineering, media and more) or study Korean language, and join cultural activities such as taekwondo classes, baseball games and museum trips.

The 2026 edition ran from 29 June with 4-week and 6-week tracks; applications ran 19 January – 15 May 2026. On-campus dormitories are available, and KU ISC announces alumni and other scholarships on its notice board.

en: Credit-bearing courses in English at a top Korean university
Korean language option and rich cultural programme
4-week and 6-week tracks

eligibility.en: University students (and some recent graduates/high-school graduates, per ISC rules) from any country; courses in English, so good English is needed.

en: Check the ISC site in January 2027 for the 2027 application
Choose your courses and programme length
Submit the online application and pay the application fee
Pay tuition by the registration due date and apply for a dormitory

costs.en: Paid: tuition per credit/course plus optional dormitory (see the ISC 'Fees & Payment' page). Some scholarships for alumni and partners.

score_reason: Large, well-run Asian summer school open to all; paid.

org: Max Planck Institute for Infection Biology (MPIIB)

name.ka: მაქს პლანკის ინფექციური ბიოლოგიის ინსტიტუტის საერთაშორისო სტაჟირება (MPIIB-ISI) 2027
name.ar: التدريب الدولي في معهد ماكس بلانك لبيولوجيا العدوى (MPIIB-ISI) 2027

deadline_note: Official timeline: call opens November 2026, deadline 27 November 2026; selection February 2027; internship 1 Sep – 30 Nov 2027.

summary.en: A fully funded three-month research internship in Berlin for international bachelor's and master's students whose access to top education is constrained, with priority for low- and middle-income countries. Stipend, travel and housing are provided.
summary.ka: სრულად დაფინანსებული სამთვიანი კვლევითი სტაჟირება ბერლინში საერთაშორისო ბაკალავრებისა და მაგისტრანტებისთვის, რომელთა წვდომა მაღალი დონის განათლებაზე შეზღუდულია; უპირატესობა დაბალი და საშუალო შემოსავლის ქვეყნებს ენიჭება. უზრუნველყოფილია სტიპენდია, მგზავრობა და საცხოვრებელი.
summary.ar: تدريب بحثي ممول بالكامل لثلاثة أشهر في برلين لطلاب البكالوريوس والماجستير الدوليين الذين يواجهون قيوداً في الوصول إلى تعليم متميز، مع أولوية للدول منخفضة ومتوسطة الدخل. يشمل منحة وسفراً وسكناً.

about.en:
The MPIIB International Summer Internship places students in research groups of the Max Planck Institute for Infection Biology in Berlin (infectious diseases, immunology, microbiology, cell biology) for three months, from 1 September to 30 November 2027. Interns work on a defined project listed on the programme website and are supported by the group's scientists.

The programme explicitly aims at talented students whose access to first-class higher education is limited by financial, regional or societal barriers, and strongly encourages applicants from low- and middle-income countries on the OECD DAC list (which includes Georgia). Interns receive a EUR 1,400 monthly stipend, travel compensation and accommodation near the institute. Selection: pre-selection, online interview, then offer letter.

en: Max Planck research project in infection biology
EUR 1,400/month stipend, travel compensation and housing
Designed for students from low- and middle-income countries

eligibility.en: International bachelor's (at least 4 semesters completed) or master's students enrolled at a university, in biology, medicine, biochemistry, epidemiology or related fields, with a strong record, good English and strong reasons why their access to first-class education is constrained. Must be available 1 Sep – 30 Nov 2027; voluntary internship only (not for credit).

en: Browse the MPIIB-ISI project list and choose a project
Write a motivation letter explaining your interest and the barriers you face
Prepare CV and transcripts
Submit the online application by 27 November 2026
Shortlisted candidates get an online interview; final decisions in February 2027

costs.en: Stipend EUR 1,400 per month, travel compensation and accommodation near the institute provided. No fees.

score_reason: Fully funded Max Planck internship aimed at students from countries like Georgia; deadline 27 Nov.

org: The Hong Kong University of Science and Technology (HKUST) Summer Campus

name.ar: برنامج HKUST الصيفي للبحث الجامعي 2027

deadline_note: HKUST page lists 2027 programme dates (arrival 10 June, research 14 June – 6 Aug) and fees; the application deadline is on the application page and not yet confirmed here.

summary.en: An eight-week research placement in an HKUST lab for undergraduates from other universities, earning 3 credits and an official transcript. Housing is on campus; fees apply.
summary.ka: რვაკვირიანი კვლევითი სტაჟირება HKUST-ის ლაბორატორიაში სხვა უნივერსიტეტების ბაკალავრებისთვის, 3 კრედიტითა და ოფიციალური ტრანსკრიპტით. საცხოვრებელი კამპუსზეა; პროგრამა ფასიანია.
summary.ar: تدريب بحثي لثمانية أسابيع في مختبر بجامعة HKUST لطلاب البكالوريوس من جامعات أخرى، مع 3 ساعات معتمدة وكشف درجات رسمي. السكن في الحرم الجامعي والبرنامج مدفوع.

about.en:
HKUST's Summer UG Research Program lets visiting undergraduates join a faculty-led research project in science, engineering, business or humanities at one of Asia's top technology universities. Participants work in the lab for eight weeks (14 June – 6 August 2027), are enrolled in a 3-credit research course, and receive an HKUST transcript sent to their home university.

Costs in 2027: application fee HKD 200, programme fee HKD 17,700 (housing in a shared on-campus room, visa, insurance, admin and activities) and tuition HKD 21,600 for 3 credits, waived for nominated exchange students from partner universities. Ask your home university whether it is an HKUST partner.

en: Wide range of research projects across HKUST schools
3 credits and an official HKUST transcript
Tuition waived for nominated exchange students

eligibility.en: Undergraduates from universities outside HKUST; check the application page for year-of-study and English requirements.

en: Browse the 2027 research projects list
Ask your home university if it can nominate you as an exchange student (tuition waiver)
Submit the online application and pay the HKD 200 fee
Arrange your Hong Kong student visa once admitted

costs.en: Application fee HKD 200; programme fee HKD 17,700 (housing, visa, insurance, admin, activities); tuition HKD 21,600 (3 credits), waived for nominated exchange students.

score_reason: Good research access at a top Asian university, but expensive unless nominated.

org: Biozentrum, University of Basel

name.ar: برنامج Biozentrum البحثي الصيفي 2027 (جامعة بازل)

deadline_note: Official page: applications for Research Summer 2027 open 4 January and close 28 February 2027 (12:00 noon CET).

summary.en: A paid summer research internship in molecular and biomedical life sciences at the University of Basel's Biozentrum, for undergraduates with Swiss or EU citizenship. No prior research experience is needed.
summary.ka: ანაზღაურებადი საზაფხულო კვლევითი სტაჟირება მოლეკულურ და ბიოსამედიცინო მეცნიერებებში ბაზელის უნივერსიტეტის Biozentrum-ში, შვეიცარიის ან ევროკავშირის მოქალაქე ბაკალავრებისთვის. წინა კვლევითი გამოცდილება საჭირო არ არის.
summary.ar: تدريب بحثي صيفي مدفوع في علوم الحياة الجزيئية والطبية الحيوية في Biozentrum بجامعة بازل لطلاب البكالوريوس من مواطني سويسرا أو الاتحاد الأوروبي. لا تُشترط خبرة بحثية سابقة.

about.en:
The Biozentrum Research Summer lets undergraduate students join a research group at the University of Basel's Biozentrum, a leading centre for molecular and biomedical research (structural biology, cell biology, neurobiology, infection biology, computational biology). The working language is English, and the internship ends with a written report on the research results.

Participants receive a time-proportional stipend of CHF 1,736 per month (gross) and a participation certificate. It is open only to Swiss or EU citizens and Swiss C-permit holders; an EU residence permit alone does not qualify.

en: Research in one of Europe's top molecular-biology institutes
No previous research experience required
Stipend CHF 1,736 per month

eligibility.en: Undergraduates in life sciences and related sciences who hold Swiss or EU citizenship or a Swiss C-permit. Not open to other nationalities.

en: Prepare a one-page motivation letter, CV and transcripts
Open the application platform between 4 January and 28 February 2027
Submit the form with all documents before 12:00 noon CET on 28 February

costs.en: Stipend CHF 1,736 per month (gross), time-proportional. Housing not provided.

score_reason: Paid research summer in Basel, but restricted to Swiss/EU citizens.

org: European Space Camp (Andøya, Norway)

name.ar: المخيم الفضائي الأوروبي 2027

deadline_note: European Space Camp says 2027 dates and the application window will be posted on its Apply page; applications for 2026 are closed. Applications usually open in winter and close in spring; check spacecamp.no.

summary.en: A week-long camp in Arctic Norway where 17–20-year-olds from around the world learn space and rocket physics and launch a real rocket. Every seat is a scholarship covering all costs except, for some seats, travel.
summary.ka: ერთკვირიანი ბანაკი არქტიკულ ნორვეგიაში, სადაც მთელი მსოფლიოს 17–20 წლის ახალგაზრდები კოსმოსურ და სარაკეტო ფიზიკას სწავლობენ და ნამდვილ რაკეტას უშვებენ. ყოველი ადგილი სტიპენდიაა, რომელიც ყველა ხარჯს ფარავს, ზოგ შემთხვევაში მგზავრობის გარდა.
summary.ar: مخيم لمدة أسبوع في شمال النرويج القطبي يتعلم فيه شباب بعمر 17–20 عاماً من أنحاء العالم فيزياء الفضاء والصواريخ ويطلقون صاروخاً حقيقياً. كل مقعد منحة تغطي جميع التكاليف ما عدا السفر في بعض المنح.

about.en:
European Space Camp (ESC) is an annual, non-profit week-long camp at the Andøya Space rocket range in northern Norway, run by former participants. Campers attend lectures on space science and rocket physics, work in groups on a hands-on rocket campaign (building payloads, analysing data) and launch a real student rocket, while meeting science-minded peers from around the world.

You cannot pay to attend: every place is tied to a scholarship (from ESA for nationals of ESA member states, national sponsors, and an 'International' seat open to any country). Scholarships cover all costs at camp; some do not cover travel. Applications have two rounds; round one asks for a video, CV and proof of English.

en: Launch a real rocket at the Andøya Space range
All seats are scholarships covering camp costs
International seat open to applicants from any country

eligibility.en: Young people aged 17–20 (2027 birth-year window to be published), with a documented passion for science and fluent English. Any nationality; specific scholarships have nationality rules.

en: Create a profile on spacecamp.no
When the 2027 window opens, upload a video, CV and proof of English proficiency (round 1)
Check which scholarship seats you are eligible for (international or national)
Complete round 2 if shortlisted

costs.en: Free for selected campers: scholarships cover all camp costs; some scholarships do not cover travel to Norway.

score_reason: Unique free rocket camp open to all nationalities; 2027 dates pending.

org: Boston University Summer Term

name.ar: برنامج High School Honors في جامعة بوسطن 2027

deadline_note: BU lists 2027 dates (27 June – 6 August 2027). Application dates for 2027 not yet posted on the overview page; BU pre-college applications usually open in winter with spring deadlines.

summary.en: Rising juniors and seniors take two real Boston University undergraduate courses for college credit over six weeks, living on campus, commuting or online.
summary.ka: მე-11 და მე-12 კლასის მოსწავლეები ექვსი კვირის განმავლობაში ბოსტონის უნივერსიტეტის ორ ნამდვილ საბაკალავრო კურსს გადიან კრედიტით, კამპუსზე ცხოვრებით, ყოველდღიური დასწრებით ან ონლაინ.
summary.ar: يدرس طلاب الصفين الحادي عشر والثاني عشر مادتين جامعيتين حقيقيتين في جامعة بوسطن بساعات معتمدة على مدى ستة أسابيع، بالإقامة في الحرم أو الحضور اليومي أو عبر الإنترنت.

about.en:
High School Honors lets strong high-school students enrol in regular BU summer courses alongside university students, choosing from more than 80 courses across the sciences, engineering, humanities, social sciences and business, and earning transferable college credit with a BU transcript.

The 2027 programme runs 27 June – 6 August in residential, commuter or online formats. International students are welcome (BU has a dedicated 'visiting international students' registration track and visa guidance). Fees include tuition per credit plus housing/dining for residential students.

en: Real BU undergraduate courses for college credit
More than 80 courses to choose from
Residential, commuter or online

eligibility.en: Rising high-school juniors and seniors with a strong academic record, including international students with sufficient English.

en: Choose two courses on the BU Summer Term site
Submit the online application with transcript, recommendation and essay
International students: provide English proficiency evidence and arrange an F-1/visa as advised by BU
Pay tuition and housing once admitted

costs.en: Paid: BU summer tuition per credit plus residential fees (published on the BU Summer Term site). Limited financial aid may be available.

score_reason: Credit-bearing BU courses for internationals; paid.

org: Boston University Summer Term

name.ar: برنامج Academic Immersion في جامعة بوسطن 2027

duration.en: 3 weeks (27 June – 16 July or 18 July – 6 August 2027)
duration.ka: 3 კვირა (2027 წლის 27 ივნისი – 16 ივლისი ან 18 ივლისი – 6 აგვისტო)
duration.ar: 3 أسابيع (27 يونيو – 16 يوليو أو 18 يوليو – 6 أغسطس 2027)

deadline_note: BU lists 2027 sessions (27 June – 16 July; 18 July – 6 August 2027); application dates not yet posted.

summary.en: A three-week deep dive into a single topic through hands-on, experiential learning at Boston University, for rising juniors and seniors.
summary.ka: სამკვირიანი სიღრმისეული სწავლება ერთ თემაზე პრაქტიკული, გამოცდილებაზე დაფუძნებული მეთოდებით ბოსტონის უნივერსიტეტში მე-11 და მე-12 კლასის მოსწავლეებისთვის.
summary.ar: تعمّق لمدة ثلاثة أسابيع في موضوع واحد عبر التعلم العملي التجريبي في جامعة بوسطن لطلاب الصفين الحادي عشر والثاني عشر.

about.en:
Academic Immersion (AIM) programmes focus on one subject for three weeks, combining classes with labs, field trips and projects around Boston; recent tracks include topics such as medicine and health, neuroscience, engineering, law and game design. Students live in BU residence halls or commute.

Two sessions in 2027: 27 June – 16 July and 18 July – 6 August. International students can apply through BU's visiting international student process.

en: Three-week single-topic immersion with field trips
Two sessions in summer 2027
Live on BU's Boston campus

eligibility.en: Rising high-school juniors and seniors, including international students with sufficient English.

en: Pick an Academic Immersion track and session
Apply online (application opens in winter)
Submit transcript and supporting documents; international students add English proficiency
Pay the programme fee and arrange travel/visa

costs.en: Paid programme fee covering tuition and (for residential students) housing and meals; see the BU site for 2027 amounts.

score_reason: Focused 3-week BU programme open internationally; paid.

org: University of Southern California (USC Pre-College)

name.ar: برامج USC الصيفية 2027 (ما قبل الجامعة)

deadline_note: USC: Summer Programs 2027 run 21 June – 16 July 2027; application information to be posted in November 2026.

summary.en: Four-week college-credit courses at USC in Los Angeles for high-school students worldwide, in fields from business and engineering to film, pre-law and pre-health.
summary.ka: ოთხკვირიანი კრედიტიანი კურსები USC-ში ლოს-ანჯელესში მთელი მსოფლიოს მოსწავლეებისთვის — ბიზნესიდან და ინჟინერიიდან კინომდე, სამართლისა და მედიცინის მოსამზადებელ მიმართულებებამდე.
summary.ar: دورات بساعات جامعية معتمدة لمدة أربعة أسابيع في USC بلوس أنجلوس لطلاب الثانوية من كل العالم، في مجالات من الأعمال والهندسة إلى السينما وما قبل القانون وما قبل الطب.

about.en:
USC Summer Programs give high-school students a four-week taste of university life at the University of Southern California, with courses taught by USC faculty that earn USC college credit. Options span architecture, business, cinematic arts, communication and journalism, engineering and computer science, global studies, performing arts, pre-health, pre-law and writing.

The 2027 programme runs 21 June – 16 July in Los Angeles, with residential and commuter options and a dedicated page for international participants. Application details are released in November 2026.

en: USC college credit in four weeks
Wide subject range incl. film, engineering and pre-law
Residential option in Los Angeles

eligibility.en: High-school students (typically grades 9–12) from any country; international participants need sufficient English and a visa.

en: Check summer.usc.edu in November 2026 for the application
Pick a programme and submit the online application with transcript
International students: follow the 'International Participants' guidance (English proficiency, visa)
Pay fees once admitted

costs.en: Paid: tuition plus residential fees (see 'Admission, Tuition and Fees' on the USC site).

score_reason: Well-known LA summer option open internationally; paid.

org: Yale University Office of International and Summer Programs

name.ar: الدورة الصيفية في جامعة Yale لعام 2027

duration.en: 5 weeks per session (31 May – 2 July or 5 July – 6 August 2027)
duration.ka: სესია 5 კვირა (2027 წლის 31 მაისი – 2 ივლისი ან 5 ივლისი – 6 აგვისტო)
duration.ar: 5 أسابيع لكل دورة (31 مايو – 2 يوليو أو 5 يوليو – 6 أغسطس 2027)

deadline_note: Yale Summer Session site: applications open 11 January 2027; Session A 31 May – 2 July, Session B 5 July – 6 August 2027. Deadlines listed on the 'Dates and Deadlines' page.

summary.en: Earn Yale College credit in five-week summer sessions alongside Yale students. Open to visiting college students, international students and qualified pre-college (high-school) students.
summary.ka: მიიღეთ Yale College-ის კრედიტი ხუთკვირიან საზაფხულო სესიებზე Yale-ის სტუდენტებთან ერთად. ღიაა სხვა უნივერსიტეტების სტუდენტებისთვის, საერთაშორისო სტუდენტებისთვის და შესაბამისი მოსწავლეებისთვის.
summary.ar: احصل على ساعات معتمدة من Yale College في دورات صيفية من خمسة أسابيع إلى جانب طلاب Yale. مفتوحة للطلاب الجامعيين الزائرين والطلاب الدوليين وطلاب الثانوية المؤهلين.

about.en:
Yale Summer Session offers Yale College courses for credit taught by Yale faculty, in New Haven, online and in hybrid formats, plus the Yale Writers' Workshop, an English Language Institute and a Conservatory for Actors. Visiting college students and international students take the same courses as Yale undergraduates and receive a Yale transcript; qualified high-school students can apply through the pre-college track.

In 2027 Session A runs 31 May – 2 July and Session B 5 July – 6 August. Applications open on 11 January 2027. Yale lists tuition, fees and a page on financial assistance.

en: Real Yale College courses and transcript
Two five-week sessions
Pre-college and international tracks

eligibility.en: Visiting undergraduates, international students and qualified pre-college students (check the pre-college page for age/grade rules). English proficiency required for non-native speakers.

en: Browse 2027 courses on summer.yale.edu
Choose your student type (visiting international, pre-college, etc.)
Apply online from 11 January 2027 with transcripts and English test if required
Check the financial assistance page
Pay tuition and housing after admission

costs.en: Paid: per-course tuition plus housing/dining for residential students (see 'Tuition and Fees'). Limited financial assistance.

score_reason: Yale credit courses open to internationals and high schoolers; paid.

org: KEDGE Business School

name.ar: مدرسة KEDGE الشتوية الدولية 2027 (باريس)

deadline_note: KEDGE page states the deadline as 'December 7, 2027', which must mean 7 December 2026 for the January 2027 intake; places are first-come, first-served.

summary.en: A two-week winter school in Paris on disruptive technologies and modern management for bachelor's and master's students, with two 5-ECTS courses and company visits.
summary.ka: ორკვირიანი ზამთრის სკოლა პარიზში დისრუფციულ ტექნოლოგიებსა და თანამედროვე მენეჯმენტზე ბაკალავრებისა და მაგისტრანტებისთვის, ორი 5-კრედიტიანი კურსითა და კომპანიების ვიზიტებით.
summary.ar: مدرسة شتوية لمدة أسبوعين في باريس حول التقنيات المُحدِثة للتغيير والإدارة الحديثة لطلاب البكالوريوس والماجستير، مع مادتين بـ5 ساعات ECTS لكل منهما وزيارات لشركات.

about.en:
KEDGE's International Winter School in Paris offers two intensive one-week modules on technology, management and innovation (each 24 contact hours, formally assessed, 5 ECTS), a business visit or talk per course, a guided tour of Paris, a welcome event and a dinner. Students can take one week (5 ECTS) or both (10 ECTS) and receive official transcripts and a certificate.

It is aimed at motivated advanced bachelor's and master's students with at least B2 English. The intake starts on 11 January 2027; places are limited and allocated first-come, first-served.

en: Two 5-ECTS courses with official transcripts
Company visits and Paris cultural programme
Flexible: one or two weeks

eligibility.en: Advanced bachelor's or master's students in good academic standing with at least B2 English, from any country.

en: Download the brochure from the KEDGE Winter School page
Apply online as early as possible (first-come, first-served)
Submit before 7 December 2026
Arrange a short-stay visa for France if needed

costs.en: Paid: tuition per course/package (see 'Admission and tuition fees'); accommodation and living costs extra. No KEDGE scholarship for the winter programme.

score_reason: Short credit-bearing Paris winter school; paid.

org: Google (Google Summer of Code)

name.ka: Google Summer of Code 2027 (Google-ის ღია კოდის საზაფხულო პროგრამა)
name.ar: برنامج Google Summer of Code 2027

duration.en: About 12 weeks of coding (May–August 2027; longer projects possible)
duration.ka: დაახლოებით 12 კვირა პროგრამირება (2027 წლის მაისი–აგვისტო; შესაძლებელია უფრო გრძელი პროექტები)
duration.ar: نحو 12 أسبوعاً من البرمجة (مايو–أغسطس 2027، مع إمكانية مشاريع أطول)

deadline_note: Google's 2026 timeline: contributor applications 16–31 March, results 30 April, coding July–August. The general timing page says the cycle repeats yearly; 2027 dates estimated from 2026 and will be confirmed in early 2027.

summary.en: A paid, remote programme where new open-source contributors aged 18+ anywhere in the world write code for an open-source organisation over the summer, guided by mentors. Google pays a stipend that depends on project size and country.
summary.ka: ანაზღაურებადი დისტანციური პროგრამა, სადაც მსოფლიოს ნებისმიერი ქვეყნის 18+ ასაკის დამწყები კონტრიბუტორები ზაფხულში ღია კოდის ორგანიზაციისთვის წერენ კოდს მენტორების ხელმძღვანელობით. Google იხდის სტიპენდიას, რომელიც პროექტის ზომასა და ქვეყანაზეა დამოკიდებული.
summary.ar: برنامج مدفوع عن بُعد يكتب فيه مساهمون جدد في المصادر المفتوحة بعمر 18 عاماً فأكثر من أي مكان في العالم شيفرة لمنظمة مفتوحة المصدر خلال الصيف بإشراف موجهين. تدفع Google منحة تعتمد على حجم المشروع والبلد.

about.en:
Google Summer of Code (GSoC) connects new contributors with hundreds of open-source organisations (programming languages, scientific software, AI tools, operating systems, education and more). After the list of mentoring organisations is published in late February, you discuss project ideas with an organisation, write a proposal, and if accepted spend the summer coding remotely with mentor support, with midterm and final evaluations.

It is open worldwide to people aged 18+ who are students or beginners in open source. Contributors receive a stipend set by project size and country purchasing power. It is a strong CV item for computer science students and a common route into internships and jobs.

en: Work remotely on real open-source software with mentors
Stipend paid by Google, scaled by project size and country
Open to beginners worldwide aged 18+

eligibility.en: Anyone aged 18+ at registration who is a student or a beginner to open-source software, from almost any country (subject to Google's legal restrictions). No need to be enrolled at a university.

en: Read the GSoC contributor guide and watch for the 2027 organisation list (late February)
Pick an organisation and discuss project ideas with its mentors early
Write a project proposal following the organisation's template
Submit your proposal during the contributor application window (mid–late March in 2026)
Accepted projects are announced at the end of April

costs.en: Free to apply. Contributors receive a stipend from Google that depends on project size (small/medium/large) and country of residence.

score_reason: Paid global open-source programme, very accessible to students anywhere.

org: Outreachy (Software Freedom Conservancy)

name.ar: تدريبات Outreachy، دفعة مايو 2027

deadline_note: Outreachy runs two cohorts a year (December and May). The May 2027 dates are not yet published; in past years initial applications opened mid-January and closed early February. Estimate only; sign up for the mailing list.

summary.en: Paid three-month remote internships in open-source and open-science projects for people facing under-representation or discrimination in tech, open worldwide. Interns receive USD 7,000.
summary.ka: ანაზღაურებადი სამთვიანი დისტანციური სტაჟირებები ღია კოდისა და ღია მეცნიერების პროექტებში ადამიანებისთვის, რომლებიც ტექნოლოგიების სფეროში არასაკმარისად არიან წარმოდგენილნი ან დისკრიმინაციას განიცდიან. ღიაა მთელი მსოფლიოსთვის; სტიპენდია 7 000 დოლარია.
summary.ar: تدريبات مدفوعة عن بُعد لمدة ثلاثة أشهر في مشاريع المصادر المفتوحة والعلوم المفتوحة للأشخاص الممثلين تمثيلاً ناقصاً أو الذين يواجهون التمييز في قطاع التقنية، مفتوحة لكل العالم. يحصل المتدرب على 7,000 دولار.

about.en:
Outreachy, a diversity initiative of Software Freedom Conservancy, offers paid, remote internships with open-source and open-science communities. Projects include programming, documentation, design, data science and community work, so you do not have to be an experienced programmer. The process has two stages: an initial application (essays about your background and the barriers you face), then a contribution period of about a month in which you make small contributions to projects before submitting a final application.

Interns work remotely for three months with experienced mentors and receive a USD 7,000 stipend. Outreachy is open to applicants around the world aged 18+ who face under-representation, systemic bias or discrimination in the tech industry of their country.

en: USD 7,000 stipend for a 3-month remote internship
No prior open-source experience needed
Open worldwide; focus on under-represented groups

eligibility.en: Applicants aged 18+ anywhere in the world who face under-representation, systemic bias or discrimination in tech in their country, and who are available full-time (about 30 hours/week) during the internship. Students must not have full-time classes during the internship period.

en: Sign up for the Outreachy mailing list to be notified when the May 2027 round opens
Submit the initial application with essays (usually January–February)

Submit a final application for your chosen project

about.en:
Imperial's Global Summer School is a two-week residential pre-university programme in London for academically strong 16- and 17-year-olds from around the world. In week one students follow a subject stream (Chemistry, Data Science & AI, Engineering, Medicine & Life Sciences or Physics) with lectures, labs and workshops; in week two they join mixed teams for an Innovation Challenge run by the Imperial Enterprise Lab. Students live in Imperial's Prince's Gardens halls and get guidance on applying to UK universities.

Places are given on a rolling, first-come basis and popular subjects fill months ahead, so apply as soon as the 2027 window opens. Imperial offers no scholarships or bursaries for this programme.

en: Subject week in chemistry, data science & AI, engineering, medicine or physics
Innovation Challenge with the Imperial Enterprise Lab
Live on campus in South Kensington; UK university application advice

eligibility.en: Aged 16 by the start and not 18 before or during the programme; mostly A*/A (9–7) at GCSE or international equivalent with at least A in maths and relevant sciences; strong English. All nationalities.

en: Register interest on the Global Summer School page to be told when 2027 applications open
Prepare predicted/recent grades, a personal statement and a teacher reference
Apply online as early as possible (rolling admission)
Pay the full fee within 14 days of an unconditional offer (7 days later in the cycle)

costs.en: 2026 fee GBP 7,695, for the residential programme (tuition and on-campus accommodation; see the fees page for exactly what is included); flights and visa extra. No scholarships, discounts or bursaries.

score_reason: Top STEM university taster for 16–17s; high fee and no financial aid.

org: NAWA – Polish National Agency for Academic Exchange

name.en: NAWA Summer Courses in Polish Language and Culture 2027
name.ka: NAWA-ს საზაფხულო კურსები პოლონური ენასა და კულტურაში 2027
name.ar: دورات NAWA الصيفية في اللغة والثقافة البولندية 2027

duration.en: 1–4 weeks on site (mostly July–August 2027); online 1–12 weeks
duration.ka: 1–4 კვირა ადგილზე (ძირითადად 2027 წლის ივლისი–აგვისტო); ონლაინ 1–12 კვირა
duration.ar: 1–4 أسابيع حضورياً (غالباً يوليو–أغسطس 2027)؛ عبر الإنترنت 1–12 أسبوعاً

deadline_note: NAWA: 2027 course dates and host universities will be announced at the beginning of December 2026; application forms open in 2027, in most cases at the beginning of February. Each university sets its own deadline (not yet published).

summary.en: Free Polish language and culture summer courses at accredited Polish universities, funded by NAWA: tuition, trips, accommodation and meals are covered; you pay only travel and insurance. For students and academic staff of foreign universities.
summary.ka: უფასო საზაფხულო კურსები პოლონურ ენასა და კულტურაში აკრედიტებულ პოლონურ უნივერსიტეტებში, NAWA-ს დაფინანსებით: სწავლა, ექსკურსიები, საცხოვრებელი და კვება დაფარულია; იხდით მხოლოდ მგზავრობასა და დაზღვევას. განკუთვნილია უცხოური უნივერსიტეტების სტუდენტებისა და აკადემიური პერსონალისთვის.
summary.ar: دورات صيفية مجانية في اللغة والثقافة البولندية في جامعات بولندية معتمدة بتمويل من NAWA: تُغطّى الدراسة والرحلات والسكن والوجبات، ولا يدفع المشارك إلا السفر والتأمين. مخصصة لطلاب الجامعات الأجنبية وأعضاء هيئاتها الأكاديمية.

about.en:
Every year the Polish National Agency for Academic Exchange (NAWA) funds summer courses in Polish language and culture run by accredited Polish universities (in 2026: Lublin, Wrocław, Toruń, Poznań, Cieszyn and others). On-site courses last 1–4 weeks and combine Polish lessons at your level with lectures and workshops on Polish history and culture, trips to major sights and meetings with Polish students and scholars. Online and 'Learn Poland', adaptation and B2-exam courses are also offered.

The courses, including accommodation and meals for on-site courses, are free; participants pay only travel to Poland and health insurance. You may attend only one on-site course per year. NAWA publishes the 2027 list of courses in early December 2026 and universities open their application forms from about February 2027; apply directly to the university you choose (up to three choices).

en: Tuition, accommodation, meals and excursions free
Courses at several leading Polish universities
Polish lessons plus culture, history and trips

eligibility.en: Students and academic teachers of foreign (non-Polish) universities who are foreigners (or dual nationals) for whom Polish is not the first language and who do not study, work or live in Poland; Polish or English at least B1 for communication. Adaptation courses are for those planning to study in Poland. Any nationality.

en: Check NAWA's Summer Courses page in December 2026 for the 2027 list
Prepare a recommendation from an academic teacher
From about February 2027, fill in the application form on the chosen university's site (you may apply to 2nd and 3rd choices)
Confirm your place quickly if accepted; only one on-site course per year

costs.en: Free: tuition, programme, excursions, accommodation and meals (on-site courses) are funded by NAWA. You pay international travel and mandatory health insurance.

score_reason: Fully covered language and culture summer school for university students of any nationality.

org: The Chinese University of Hong Kong (Office of Academic Links)

name.ka: ჰონკონგის ჩინური უნივერსიტეტის საერთაშორისო საზაფხულო სკოლა 2027
name.ar: المدرسة الصيفية الدولية في الجامعة الصينية بهونغ كونغ 2027

duration.en: About 5 weeks (late June – July 2027; August session also offered)
duration.ka: დაახლოებით 5 კვირა (2027 წლის ივნისის ბოლო – ივლისი; ასევე აგვისტოს სესია)
duration.ar: نحو 5 أسابيع (أواخر يونيو – يوليو 2027، مع دورة في أغسطس أيضاً)

deadline_note: Estimated from 2026 pattern: non-local fee-paying applicants had until 30 April 2026 (early-bird tuition discount before 31 March 2026). 2027 dates not yet announced.

summary.en: English-taught credit courses (up to 6 CUHK credits) plus Putonghua and Cantonese at CUHK's Sha Tin campus, with hostel living and cultural trips, for undergraduates and admitted high-school seniors.
summary.ka: ინგლისურენოვანი კრედიტიანი კურსები (6 CUHK კრედიტამდე) და მანდარინული/კანტონური ჩინური ენა CUHK-ის შა-ტინის კამპუსზე, საერთო საცხოვრებლით და კულტურული ექსკურსიებით, ბაკალავრებისა და უნივერსიტეტში უკვე ჩარიცხული აბიტურიენტებისთვის.
summary.ar: مقررات معتمدة باللغة الإنجليزية (حتى 6 ساعات معتمدة) إضافة إلى الماندرين والكانتونية في حرم الجامعة الصينية بهونغ كونغ في شا تين، مع سكن جامعي ورحلات ثقافية، لطلاب البكالوريوس وطلاب الثانوية المقبولين في جامعات.

about.en:
The CUHK International Summer School (ISS) lets students take up to two three-credit courses in five academic areas, taught in English by CUHK and visiting overseas professors, as well as beginner Putonghua or Cantonese. The 2026 July session ran 21 June – 29 July with about 20 content courses, on-campus hostel accommodation, orientation, a farewell dinner and weekend cultural excursions around Hong Kong; an August session is also offered.

It is open to full-time undergraduates and to high-school seniors with a confirmed university offer. Students whose university is a CUHK exchange partner may be nominated (tuition waived); everyone else applies as a non-local fee-paying student.

en: Up to 6 transferable CUHK credits
Chinese language (Putonghua/Cantonese) plus English-taught courses
On-campus hostel and Hong Kong cultural programme

eligibility.en: Full-time undergraduates at any recognised university, and secondary-school seniors who hold a confirmed offer from a recognised university. All nationalities (non-local fee-paying route).

en: Check the CUHK Summer Programmes site for the 2027 ISS dates and course list
Apply online as a non-local fee-paying student (or via your exchange office if CUHK is a partner)
Apply before the early-bird date (31 March in 2026) for discounted tuition
Submit transcripts and documents; pay fees and arrange the Hong Kong student visa

costs.en: 2026: early-bird tuition HK$8,150 per course for fee-paying students; exchange students pay no tuition but pay hostel (HK$6,080), activities (HK$4,000) and visa fees. Airfare and meals extra.

score_reason: Solid credit summer school in Hong Kong; deadline estimated from 2026.

org: Freie Universität Berlin (FUBiS – International Summer and Winter University)

name.en: FUBiS Winter University 2027 (Term I, Freie Universität Berlin)
name.ka: FUBiS ზამთრის უნივერსიტეტი 2027 (I ტერმი, ბერლინის თავისუფალი უნივერსიტეტი)
name.ar: جامعة FUBiS الشتوية 2027 (الفصل الأول، جامعة برلين الحرة)

deadline_note: FUBiS fees page: Term I 2027 registration deadline 23 November 2026; EUR 75 early-registration discount until 9 November 2026.

summary.en: A three-week winter term at Freie Universität Berlin: one intensive German language class or an English-taught subject class for credit, plus Berlin excursions. Registration closes 23 November 2026.
summary.ka: სამკვირიანი ზამთრის ტერმი ბერლინის თავისუფალ უნივერსიტეტში: გერმანული ენის ინტენსიური კურსი ან ინგლისურენოვანი საგნობრივი კურსი კრედიტებით და ექსკურსიები ბერლინში. რეგისტრაცია სრულდება 2026 წლის 23 ნოემბერს.
summary.ar: فصل شتوي لمدة ثلاثة أسابيع في جامعة برلين الحرة: مقرر مكثف في اللغة الألمانية أو مقرر تخصصي بالإنجليزية بساعات معتمدة، مع رحلات في برلين. يغلق التسجيل في 23 نوفمبر 2026.

about.en:
FUBiS is the international summer and winter university of Freie Universität Berlin. Term I 2027 is its winter session, running 4–22 January 2027 (arrival to departure): students take a semi-intensive German language class at their level or an English-taught subject class, with optional excursions such as a day trip to Potsdam and a tour of Berlin's underground.

FUBiS issues an official transcript (credits can be transferred if you are or were enrolled at a university); most subject classes are taught in English and German classes are placed by level after an online placement test. The programme fee includes a sealed transcript, a guided tour of the Reichstag, a student ID with canteen discounts, library and Wi-Fi access and welcome/farewell events. FUBiS does not award its own scholarships; it points students to the DAAD database and home-country funding.

en: Three-week credit-bearing course in Berlin in January
German at all levels or English-taught subject classes
Reichstag tour, transcript and student ID included in the programme fee

eligibility.en: Aged 18+ with at least one year of university study completed by the start (adult learners and professionals also accepted, but credits only for current/former university students). Courses taught in German need advanced-intermediate German. Open to all nationalities; non-EU citizens may need a visa.

en: Pick a German or subject class on fubis.org (Term I 2027)
Register online by 23 November 2026 (by 9 November for the EUR 75 discount)
Pay the programme fee and tuition within one week of registering
Book housing through FUBiS and arrange a visa if needed

costs.en: Term I 2027: programme fee EUR 425 (EUR 75 off until 9 Nov 2026) + tuition EUR 1,475 per class. Optional housing e.g. Studentendorf EUR 635, homestay EUR 650, guesthouse EUR 520; insurance package EUR 45. No FUBiS scholarships.

score_reason: Open now, short deadline; credible credit course in Berlin at moderate cost.

org: Freie Universität Berlin (FUBiS – International Summer and Winter University)

name.ar: جامعة FUBiS الصيفية 2027 (جامعة برلين الحرة)

duration.en: 6 weeks (29 May – 10 July 2027) or 4 weeks (17 July – 14 August 2027)
duration.ka: 6 კვირა (2027 წლის 29 მაისი – 10 ივლისი) ან 4 კვირა (17 ივლისი – 14 აგვისტო)
duration.ar: 6 أسابيع (29 مايو – 10 يوليو 2027) أو 4 أسابيع (17 يوليو – 14 أغسطس 2027)

deadline_note: FUBiS fees page: Term II (29 May – 10 July 2027) registration deadline 1 May 2027 (EUR 75 discount until 3 April); Term III (17 July – 14 August 2027) deadline 19 June 2027 (discount until 22 May).

summary.en: More than 60 credit courses in Berlin each summer: German language at every level and English-taught subject classes, in a 6-week or 4-week term, with excursions and a cultural programme.
summary.ka: 60-ზე მეტი კრედიტიანი კურსი ბერლინში ყოველ ზაფხულს: გერმანული ენა ყველა დონეზე და ინგლისურენოვანი საგნობრივი კურსები 6- ან 4-კვირიან ტერმში, ექსკურსიებითა და კულტურული პროგრამით.
summary.ar: أكثر من 60 مقرراً معتمداً في برلين كل صيف: اللغة الألمانية بجميع المستويات ومقررات تخصصية بالإنجليزية، في فصل من 6 أو 4 أسابيع مع رحلات وبرنامج ثقافي.

about.en:
Each summer FUBiS, the international summer school of Freie Universität Berlin, offers more than 60 courses in two terms: Term II (six weeks, 29 May – 10 July 2027) and Term III (four weeks, 17 July – 14 August 2027). Students can combine a German class with a subject class, or take two subject classes that may count toward a major or minor at home, with excursions to places such as Potsdam and Leipzig.

FUBiS issues an official transcript (credits can be transferred if you are or were enrolled at a university); most subject classes are taught in English and German classes are placed by level after an online placement test. The programme fee includes a sealed transcript, a guided tour of the Reichstag, a student ID with canteen discounts, library and Wi-Fi access and welcome/farewell events. FUBiS does not award its own scholarships; it points students to the DAAD database and home-country funding.

en: 60+ courses: German at all levels and English-taught subject classes
Choose a 6-week or 4-week term, or combine language and subject classes
Transcript with credits, Reichstag tour and Berlin cultural programme

eligibility.en: Aged 18+ with at least one year of university study completed by the start (adult learners and professionals also accepted, but credits only for current/former university students). Courses taught in German need advanced-intermediate German. Open to all nationalities; non-EU citizens may need a visa.

en: Browse Term II/III 2027 courses on fubis.org
Register online (Term II by 1 May 2027; Term III by 19 June 2027; register early for the EUR 75 discount)
Pay the programme fee and tuition within one week
Arrange housing through FUBiS and a visa if needed

costs.en: 2027: programme fee EUR 425 (EUR 75 early discount); tuition EUR 1,975 per class in Term II, EUR 1,475 in Term III; housing and excursions extra (prices for summer to be announced). No FUBiS scholarships.

score_reason: Dates, fees and deadlines for 2027 already published; flexible credit summer school.

org: University of Amsterdam (UvA Summer School)

name.ar: المدرسة الصيفية في جامعة أمستردام 2027

deadline_note: UvA scholarships page: early application deadline for the U21 Full Scholarship is Sunday 7 February 2027. Other programmes have their own (later) deadlines on each programme page; partial scholarships and travel grants are first-come, first-served.

summary.en: Dozens of English-taught summer programmes in Amsterdam for bachelor's and master's students (and some for pre-university students), with travel grants, partial scholarships and 10 full scholarships for U21 universities.
summary.ka: ათობით ინგლისურენოვანი საზაფხულო პროგრამა ამსტერდამში ბაკალავრიატისა და მაგისტრატურის სტუდენტებისთვის (ზოგი სკოლის მოსწავლეებისთვისაც), მგზავრობის გრანტებით, ნაწილობრივი სტიპენდიებითა და U21-ის უნივერსიტეტებისთვის 10 სრული სტიპენდიით.
summary.ar: عشرات البرامج الصيفية باللغة الإنجليزية في أمستردام لطلاب البكالوريوس والماجستير (وبعضها لطلاب ما قبل الجامعة)، مع منح سفر ومنح جزئية و10 منح كاملة لجامعات شبكة U21.

about.en:
The UvA Summer School runs a wide range of short English-taught programmes in Amsterdam each summer, on topics such as peacebuilding, space law, the circular city, placemaking, mindfulness, sexuality studies and creative writing, at bachelor's, master's and professional level, with a few pre-university options. Programmes typically last one to four weeks and include university housing and a social programme; online winter courses run in January.

Funding is unusually good for a European summer school: the Amsterdam University Fund travel grant (EUR 400 for non-European residents, EUR 200 for Europeans, need-based), EUR 300 partial scholarships for students at UNICA, Universitas 21 or LERU universities, and 10 full-tuition U21 scholarships with an early deadline of 7 February 2027. Only one scholarship per applicant, and not every programme participates.

en: Large choice of English-taught programmes in Amsterdam
Need-based AUF travel grant (EUR 400 for non-Europeans)
10 full-tuition U21 scholarships; EUR 300 network scholarships

eligibility.en: Varies by programme: most require current bachelor's or master's enrolment (some accept professionals; pre-university programmes for secondary students). Open to all nationalities. Scholarships depend on the programme and, for U21/UNICA/LERU awards, on your home university.

en: Choose a 2027 programme on the UvA Summer School programme list
Check on the programme page whether it offers the AUF travel grant or network scholarships
Apply online with a motivation letter (add a one-page need statement for the AUF grant)
For the U21 Full Scholarship, apply by 7 February 2027 with the scholarship addendum
Pay housing within two weeks of acceptance

costs.en: Tuition and housing vary by programme (see each page). Scholarships: AUF travel grant EUR 200/400, UNICA/U21/LERU partial EUR 300, U21 full tuition (housing not included), alumni discount EUR 100.

score_reason: Broad, reputable summer school with real (if limited) scholarships including travel grants for non-Europeans.

org: Utrecht Summer School (Utrecht University, HU, HKU, University of Humanistic Studies)

name.ar: مدرسة أوترخت الصيفية 2027

deadline_note: The site says it hopes to welcome students in summer 2027; the 2027 course list, registration opening and per-course deadlines are not yet published. Each course has its own deadline; check the course pages from early 2027.

summary.en: The Netherlands' largest academic summer programme: about 160 English-taught courses at bachelor's, master's and PhD level in Utrecht (plus tracks abroad), most with EC credits.
summary.ka: ნიდერლანდების უდიდესი აკადემიური საზაფხულო პროგრამა: დაახლოებით 160 ინგლისურენოვანი კურსი ბაკალავრიატის, მაგისტრატურისა და დოქტორანტურის დონეზე უტრეხტში (და საზღვარგარეთ), უმეტესობა ECTS კრედიტებით.
summary.ar: أكبر برنامج صيفي أكاديمي في هولندا: نحو 160 دورة باللغة الإنجليزية لمستويات البكالوريوس والماجستير والدكتوراه في أوترخت (ومسارات في الخارج)، ومعظمها بساعات معتمدة.

about.en:
Founded in 1986, the Utrecht Summer School is a partnership of Utrecht University, HU University of Applied Sciences, HKU University of the Arts and the University of Humanistic Studies, and is one of the biggest summer schools in Europe. It offers about 160 fully accredited courses taught in English across humanities, social sciences, law, business and economics, life sciences, healthcare, data science, science, engineering, art and music and languages, at bachelor's, master's and PhD level, with some international tracks in Florence, Rome, Berlin or Riga and some online courses.

Most courses award EC credits, and participants can use campus sports facilities and join a social programme (canal canoeing, pub quizzes and more). Applicants may apply for up to three courses; each course sets its own entry requirements, fee and deadline.

en: About 160 accredited English-taught courses
Bachelor's, master's and PhD levels; most give EC credits
Lively social programme in a historic student city

eligibility.en: Depends on the course: most target bachelor's, master's or PhD students; some accept professionals. Open to all nationalities; English proficiency required.

en: Browse the 2027 course list once published (early 2027)
Check the course's level, entry requirements and deadline
Apply online for up to three courses (ask approval for more)
Arrange housing via the summer school and a visa if needed

costs.en: Tuition and housing vary per course and are listed on each course page; no general scholarship scheme is advertised.

score_reason: Huge, reputable course choice; 2027 details not yet out.

org: Maastricht University (Maastricht Summer School)

name.ar: مدرسة ماستريخت الصيفية 2027

deadline_note: Maastricht Summer School: 'Our 2027 course offer is currently under development, and we look forward to welcoming your application in the new year.' Deadlines are set per course and not yet published.

summary.en: Short summer courses in art and culture, business and economics, law and politics, science and social sciences at Maastricht University for bachelor's and master's students and professionals.
summary.ka: მოკლე საზაფხულო კურსები ხელოვნებასა და კულტურაში, ბიზნესსა და ეკონომიკაში, სამართალსა და პოლიტიკაში, საბუნებისმეტყველო და სოციალურ მეცნიერებებში მაასტრიხტის უნივერსიტეტში ბაკალავრებისთვის, მაგისტრანტებისა და პროფესიონალებისთვის.
summary.ar: دورات صيفية قصيرة في الفن والثقافة والأعمال والاقتصاد والقانون والسياسة والعلوم والعلوم الاجتماعية في جامعة ماستريخت لطلاب البكالوريوس والماجستير والمهنيين.

about.en:
Maastricht Summer School (MSS), founded in 2012, offers short summer courses that complement Maastricht University's degree programmes, in Art & Culture, Business & Economics, Law & Politics, Science, Social Sciences and Lifelong Learning. Recent courses included Development Economics, Gender, Conflict and Peacebuilding, Digital Transformations in Public Health and Introduction to Data Analytics, taught in Maastricht's problem-based, small-group style.

Courses are aimed at undergraduate and graduate students and professionals, with a social programme in one of the Netherlands' most international student cities. The 2027 course list is being prepared and applications open in early 2027.

en: Problem-based learning in small international groups
Courses from economics and law to public health and data analytics
Social programme in a historic, very international city

eligibility.en: Bachelor's or master's students and professionals, depending on the course; all nationalities. English proficiency required.

en: Check maastrichtsummerschool.nl for the 2027 course list (early 2027)
Choose a course and check level, fee and deadline
Apply online with the requested documents
Book housing and arrange a visa if needed

costs.en: Fees vary per course (listed on each course page once published); housing extra.

score_reason: Good-quality short courses; 2027 offer still being built.

org: Seoul National University (Office of Global Affairs)

Seoul National University's International Winter Program runs from 19 December 2026 to 9 January 2027 on the Gwanak campus. Students take English-taught courses for 3 or 5 SNU credits (classes 21 December – 8 January, with final exams on the last day), live in the SNU dormitory and join curated field trips (26 December and 2 January) to regional cities, local festivals and lesser-known attractions, plus winter sports and K-pop dance classes.

The programme is open to university students and to high-school graduates admitted to a university for spring 2027. The deadline is very close, so apply immediately if interested.

en: 3 or 5 SNU credits in three weeks
Field trips, winter sports and Korean culture activities
Korea's most prestigious university

Apply and register for courses by 6 November 2026
Pay fees (application, tuition, dormitory) by 13 November 2026
Apply for a Korean visa if required

about.en:
Since 2007 more than two thousand students have joined the SNU International Summer Program (ISP), an intensive summer session at Korea's most prestigious university. Courses are taught in English by SNU and visiting faculty, covering Korea and East Asia (students mention topics such as Hallyu, K-pop and K-drama) and a range of other disciplines; students can take up to 9 credits, live in the campus dormitory and join field trips and cultural activities around Seoul.

Registration usually opens in early January, with a 20% tuition discount for registering by early April. The programme suits university students who want transferable credits and an immersive summer in Korea; high-school graduates already admitted to a university can also apply.

en: Up to 9 SNU credits in English-taught courses
Korean studies plus a wide range of other subjects
20% early-bird tuition discount; campus dormitory and field trips

eligibility.en: University students from any country, and high-school graduates admitted to a university for the autumn semester. All nationalities.

en: Join the ISP mailing list or check summer.snu.ac.kr from January 2027
Register and choose courses online (early-bird by about 5 April)
Submit enrolment/admission proof and passport details
Pay the invoice (application fee, tuition, optional dorm and field trip) by mid-May

costs.en: 2026: application fee KRW 200,000; tuition KRW 1,800,000 for one 3-credit course up to KRW 3,348,000 for up to 9 credits (20% early-bird discount); dormitory KRW 1,100,000; field trip KRW 300,000. Meals extra.

score_reason: Well-established credit summer school at Korea's top university; dates estimated from 2026.

about.en:
The Summer Schools of Slavonic Studies (SSSS) are three- to four-week Czech language courses held every July and August at Charles University (Prague and Poděbrady), Masaryk University (Brno), Palacký University (Olomouc), the University of West Bohemia (Pilsen) and the University of South Bohemia (České Budějovice). Levels run from absolute beginner (A0) to C1, with lectures on Czech culture and history and excursions; teaching is in Czech or via English depending on your level.

The Czech Ministry of Education offers scholarships that cover tuition plus board and lodging in student dormitories. In 2026 citizens of about 40 countries could apply, including Georgia; Qatar is not on the list. Candidates must be at least 18, be students or graduates (or academics in Czech/Slavic studies), and must first be selected and nominated by their country's nominating institution before registering in the ministry's online system.

en: Tuition, accommodation and meals covered by the Czech government
Six university summer schools, all levels A0–C1
Georgia is among the eligible countries

eligibility.en: Aged 18+, university students or graduates (priority to students, teachers, translators and scholars of Czech/Slavic studies) who are citizens of an eligible country; Georgia was eligible in 2026. Must be nominated by the national nominating institution (e.g. the Czech Embassy). Qatar not listed.

en: Contact the nominating institution in your country (for Georgia, the Czech Embassy in Tbilisi) in early 2027 and ask for its deadline
Submit its application form and any documents it requires
If nominated, register in the Czech Ministry's online system and complete the scholarship application in Czech or English
Choose only from the summer schools allocated to your country
Arrange travel and compulsory travel medical insurance

costs.en: Scholarship covers tuition and board and lodging in a student dormitory. Not covered: international travel and insurance (non-EU citizens must buy travel medical insurance).

score_reason: Fully covered (except travel) government language summer school with Georgia explicitly eligible.

about.en:
Each year Latvia's State Education Development Agency (VIAA) awards state scholarships for participation in summer schools run by Latvian higher education institutions, under bilateral education agreements. VIAA publishes a list of eligible summer schools (Latvian language and culture courses as well as subject-specific schools) and pays EUR 1,000 per participant directly to the organiser for the duration of the school.

Citizens of agreement countries can apply, and Georgia, Azerbaijan and Ukraine are explicitly listed among them. Only students and academic or research staff of foreign higher education institutions are eligible. Applications and documents go directly to the summer school organiser, and VIAA's committee makes the final decision; participants pay their own travel.

en: EUR 1,000 scholarship paid to the summer school
Choose from VIAA's list of Latvian university summer schools
Georgia is an eligible country under a bilateral agreement

eligibility.en: Students and academic/research staff of foreign higher education institutions who are citizens of countries with an education agreement with Latvia (including Georgia, Azerbaijan and Ukraine) or that offer reciprocal scholarships. Qatar is not listed.

en: Check VIAA's summer schools page and the list of 2027 summer schools when the call opens (around 1 February 2027)
Choose a summer school and read its application instructions
Send the summer school application form and required documents directly to the Latvian organiser by the deadline (1 April in 2026)
Wait for the organiser to inform you of VIAA's decision

costs.en: Scholarship EUR 1,000 per person for the whole summer school, transferred to the organiser (no cash to the student). Travel to Latvia is self-funded.

score_reason: Government-funded summer school place with Georgia explicitly eligible; small award covering course costs.

about.en:
The EKKAV programme (Estonian Language and Culture Academic Studies abroad) offers scholarships for international university students to attend Estonian language and culture summer and winter courses in Estonia, such as the Tallinn University winter course. The scholarship covers the course participation fee, accommodation and the cultural excursions of the course; travel is self-funded.

Applicants must be enrolled at a foreign university (BA, MA or PhD) and be studying or have studied Estonian. You register for the course yourself and send Harno a signed application describing the value of the course to you, with a recommendation from your Estonian lecturer or other proof of your Estonian. The current round is open until 15 November 2026.

en: Covers course fee, accommodation and excursions
Winter and summer Estonian language courses in Estonia
Short application: motivation statement plus lecturer's recommendation

eligibility.en: Students enrolled at a non-Estonian university (bachelor's, master's or PhD) who are studying or have previously studied Estonian. Any nationality.

en: Choose an Estonian language summer or winter course and register for it yourself
Download the EKKAV application form from Harno's page
Sign the form digitally or by hand and scan it
Email it with a recommendation from your Estonian lecturer (or proof of Estonian) to Harno by 15 November 2026, subject 'Suve- ja talvekursuste stipendium (EKKAV)'

costs.en: Scholarship covers the course participation fee, accommodation and cultural excursions. Travel to Estonia is paid by the student.

score_reason: Funded and open now, but only for students who already study Estonian.

summary.en: A two-week intensive Slovene course at the University of Ljubljana (3–4 ECTS) with lectures, workshops and cultural events. Scholarships are available for people promoting Slovene culture and for Slovene diaspora.
summary.ka: ორკვირიანი ინტენსიური სლოვენური ენის კურსი ლიუბლიანის უნივერსიტეტში (3–4 ECTS) ლექციებით, ვორქშოფებითა და კულტურული ღონისძიებებით. სტიპენდიები ხელმისაწვდომია სლოვენური კულტურის პოპულარიზატორებისა და სლოვენური დიასპორისთვის.
summary.ar: دورة مكثفة في اللغة السلوفينية لمدة أسبوعين في جامعة ليوبليانا (3–4 ساعات ECTS) مع محاضرات وورش عمل وفعاليات ثقافية، مع منح لمن يروّجون للثقافة السلوفينية وللجاليات السلوفينية.

about.en:
The Summer School of Slovene Language is run by the Centre for Slovene as a Second and Foreign Language at the University of Ljubljana's Faculty of Arts. From 5 to 16 July 2027 participants take a morning course (four 45-minute lessons a day, Monday–Friday) at their level, can add an afternoon conversation elective, and join an accompanying programme of lectures, workshops, cultural events and sport about three times a week. The course is worth 60–80 class hours (3–4 ECTS).

Anyone interested in learning Slovene can register. The Jana Zemljarič Miklavčič Scholarship Trust funds a few places (including two grants for the two-week summer school) for candidates without Slovene background who are actively engaged in Slovene culture or promote Slovenia; members of Slovene minorities abroad and descendants of emigrants can apply for ministry scholarships covering tuition.

en: Intensive Slovene at all levels, 3–4 ECTS
Lectures, workshops, cultural and sports programme in Ljubljana
Scholarship trust grants for non-Slovene promoters of Slovene culture

eligibility.en: Adults who want to learn Slovene; all nationalities. Jana Zemljarič Miklavčič grants: people without Slovene background who are active in Slovene culture or promote Slovenia. Ministry scholarships: members of Slovene minorities abroad and descendants of Slovene emigrants.

en: Fill in the Summer School application form on centerslo.si
For the Jana Zemljarič Miklavčič grant, email your application by 1 May 2027
For the diaspora scholarship, use the online scholarship form by 15 May 2027
Pay the tuition (if not on a scholarship) and arrange accommodation and travel

costs.en: EUR 785 for the two-week morning course and EUR 240 for the afternoon elective; tuition covers learning materials and the accompanying programme. Accommodation and travel extra unless covered by a scholarship.

score_reason: Affordable language summer school with 2027 dates set; scholarships are few and targeted.

summary.ka: სამკვირიანი ინგლისურენოვანი ზამთრის პროგრამა ჩინეთის ერთ-ერთ საუკეთესო უნივერსიტეტში, შანხაიში: კრედიტიანი კურსები ეკონომიკაში, ფინანსებში, ხელოვნურ ინტელექტსა და ჩინურ საზოგადოებაში, ჩინური ენა, კომპანიების ვიზიტები და კულტურული აქტივობები.

about.en:
Fudan University's International Winter Session is an annual three-week English-taught study programme for college students from around the world, held on Fudan's Shanghai campus from 21 December 2026 to 8 January 2027. Students take 2-credit content courses such as International Trade, China's Modern Economy, Corporate Finance, Artificial Intelligence in FinTech and Social Networks and Chinese Society, and can add Chinese language. The fee includes cultural activities and a company visit.

The programme is open to university students with sufficient English. Applications close on 9 November 2026 for non-Chinese applicants, so act quickly. Accommodation is not included (Fudan provides an off-campus housing list), and Fudan is not offering scholarships for its 2026 sessions.

en: Fudan credits in English-taught courses on China, business and AI
Chinese language option, company visit and cultural activities
Shanghai over New Year

eligibility.en: College/university students of any nationality with sufficient English and in good health. Applicants of Chinese nationality apply through a separate route.

en: Create an account on Fudan's online application system and select the 2026 Fudan International Winter Session (self-paying)
Upload the required documents and submit by 11:00 Beijing time, 9 November 2026
Pay the CNY 400 application fee
After admission, pay tuition by 7 December 2026 and arrange housing and an X2/visa as instructed

costs.en: Application fee CNY 400; tuition CNY 18,000 (early-bird CNY 16,200 has passed), including courses, cultural activities and company visit. Accommodation, insurance and travel not included. No Fudan scholarships in 2026.

score_reason: Open winter programme at a top Chinese university, closing 9 November.

summary.ar: مقررات معتمدة بالإنجليزية (حتى 6 ساعات معتمدة) عن الصين ومجالات أخرى في جامعة بكين، في دورات من أسبوعين أو أربعة أسابيع، لطلاب الجامعات بعمر 18–40 عاماً.

about.en:
Peking University Summer School International (PKUSSI), which held its 18th edition in 2026, brings university students from around the world to PKU's Beijing campus each July. Students choose courses taught in English by PKU faculty, for up to 6 PKU credits, in Session A, Session B (two weeks each) or both (four weeks); in 2026 these ran 6–17 July and 20–31 July.

Applicants must be 18–40, currently at college or university, and submit a transcript, an English personal statement and proof of English. Admission is competitive and based on overall performance. Applications open around New Year on PKU's online system (studyatpku.com), with a cheaper early-bird rate for those who pay by the end of March.

en: Courses taught by Peking University faculty
Up to 6 PKU credits in 2 or 4 weeks
Beijing campus with cultural activities

eligibility.en: Aged 18–40, currently enrolled at a college or university, with good academic records and English proficiency (TOEFL/IELTS/GRE as reference) for non-native speakers. All nationalities.

en: Register at studyatpku.com and choose Non-Degree Program > Short-term Program > Summer School International
Upload passport page, stamped transcript, English personal statement and English proof
Pay the RMB 400 application fee
Pay tuition by 31 March for the early-bird rate; final deadline 31 May (2026 pattern)

costs.en: 2026: application fee RMB 400; tuition RMB 15,000 (up to 4 credits) or 17,000 (5–6 credits) early bird, RMB 16,000/18,000 regular. Accommodation, travel and insurance extra.

score_reason: Summer school at China's top university; dates estimated from a stable annual pattern.

org: University College London (UCL Summer School)

name.ar: المدرسة الصيفية في كلية لندن الجامعية (UCL) 2027

deadline_note: UCL: applications open 1 December 2026; deadline 2 June 2027 for Session One or both sessions, 23 June 2027 for Session Two. Free to apply before 1 March 2027 (GBP 60 fee after). Late applications considered only for students who do not need a UK visa.

summary.en: Credit-bearing undergraduate modules taught by UCL academics in central London, in one or two three-week sessions, for students with at least one year of university study. Guaranteed UCL accommodation.
summary.ka: UCL-ის აკადემიკოსების მიერ ლონდონის ცენტრში სწავლებული კრედიტიანი ბაკალავრიატის მოდულები ერთ ან ორ სამკვირიან სესიაში, სტუდენტებისთვის, რომლებსაც უნივერსიტეტში მინიმუმ ერთი წელი აქვთ ნასწავლი. UCL-ის საცხოვრებელი გარანტირებულია.
summary.ar: وحدات دراسية جامعية معتمدة يدرّسها أكاديميو UCL في وسط لندن، في دورة أو دورتين مدة كل منهما ثلاثة أسابيع، للطلاب الذين أتموا سنة جامعية واحدة على الأقل، مع سكن مضمون في UCL.

about.en:
Every July and August UCL, one of the world's top-ranked universities, runs a summer school in Bloomsbury, central London, for students from universities worldwide (in 2026, from 50 countries and over 250 universities). Students choose from 50+ undergraduate modules developed by UCL academics for credit and taught face to face, studying one module per three-week session or two modules across both sessions (six weeks); many modules use London itself through excursions.

The programme is for students who have completed at least one year of undergraduate study (second- and third-year students and graduates are common; some postgraduates and professionals). Participants are guaranteed discounted UCL accommodation and can join an evening and weekend social and cultural programme. Apply before 1 March 2027 to avoid the GBP 60 application fee.

en: 50+ credit-bearing modules taught by UCL academics
One or two three-week sessions in central London
Guaranteed UCL accommodation and a social programme

eligibility.en: Students who have completed at least one year of undergraduate study (typically 2:2/3.0 GPA for lower-level modules, 2:1/3.3 GPA otherwise), plus postgraduates and some professionals; under-18s only if accompanied by a parent/guardian. English requirement via nationality, prior study or an accepted test. All nationalities.

en: Explore the modules and choose a preferred and an alternative module
Apply online from 1 December 2026 with transcript, English evidence and a 250-word personal statement
Apply before 1 March 2027 to avoid the GBP 60 fee
Accept the offer and pay tuition in full; book UCL accommodation
Apply for a UK visa if needed (deadlines: 2 June / 23 June 2027)

costs.en: 2027 tuition: GBP 3,100 for one session, GBP 5,100 for both; application fee GBP 60 from 1 March 2027 (free before). Excursion entry costs included; accommodation, food and travel extra.

score_reason: Top-ranked London university with 2027 dates, fees and deadlines published.

org: Scottish Universities' International Summer School (SUISS), University of Edinburgh

deadline_note: SUISS application page: regular deadline 26 April 2027; scholarship deadline 29 March 2027. Apply early to secure a place and accommodation.

summary.en: Literature, creative writing, queer studies and theatre courses at the University of Edinburgh during festival season, with full and partial scholarships for students in financial need.
summary.ka: ლიტერატურის, შემოქმედებითი წერის, ქვიარ კვლევებისა და თეატრის კურსები ედინბურგის უნივერსიტეტში ფესტივალების სეზონზე, სრული და ნაწილობრივი სტიპენდიებით ფინანსური საჭიროების მქონე სტუდენტებისთვის.
summary.ar: دورات في الأدب والكتابة الإبداعية ودراسات الكوير والمسرح في جامعة إدنبرة خلال موسم المهرجانات، مع منح كاملة وجزئية للطلاب ذوي الحاجة المالية.

about.en:
The Scottish Universities' International Summer School, based at the University of Edinburgh, has run summer courses in literature and the arts for decades. In 2027 it runs from 12 July to 21 August with the Text and Context programme (Modernism, Contemporary Literature, Scottish Literature), a four-week Creative Writing course with author masterclasses, a Queer Studies course and a two-week Contemporary British and Irish Theatre and Performance course timed with the Edinburgh International Festival and Fringe. Teaching combines daily lectures by guest scholars with small seminars; credit is available for an extra fee.

SUISS offers full and partial scholarships funded by sponsors for applicants from specific countries, in specific subjects, or exceptional literature students who could not attend without help; awards are based on financial need, merit and likely contribution. Scholarship applicants apply on the regular form (page 4) with a supporting letter by 29 March 2027.

en: Courses timed with the Edinburgh festivals
Creative writing with acclaimed authors' masterclasses
Full and partial need-based scholarships

eligibility.en: Students and others with strong English (one reference must certify your fluency and abilities as a student); courses are pitched at an advanced level. All nationalities; some scholarships are restricted to certain countries or subjects.

en: Download the application form for your chosen course(s) from the SUISS application page
Include one academic or employer reference and, for scholarships, a letter explaining why you should be considered
Email the form to suiss@ed.ac.uk with a GBP 100 deposit (scholarship applicants exempt)
Scholarship deadline 29 March 2027; regular deadline 26 April 2027

costs.en: Course fees (by length) e.g. Text & Context GBP 1,167 / 2,076 / 3,075; Creative Writing GBP 2,334–3,520; optional credit fee GBP 80–200; catered study-room accommodation GBP 864 (2 weeks) to GBP 2,880 (6 weeks). Fees include weekday lunches and a social programme. Scholarships cover fees fully or partly.

score_reason: Distinctive literature and writing summer school with scholarships and 2027 deadlines set.

name.en: University of St Andrews Summer Academic Experience Courses 2027
name.ka: სენტ-ენდრიუსის უნივერსიტეტის საზაფხულო აკადემიური გამოცდილების კურსები 2027

summary.en: Three-week residential university courses for 16–18-year-olds at the UK's top-ranked university (Times/Sunday Times 2027): management, creative writing, sustainability, cinema and more, with full scholarships for one course.
summary.ka: სამკვირიანი საცხოვრებლიანი საუნივერსიტეტო კურსები 16–18 წლის მოსწავლეებისთვის დიდი ბრიტანეთის საუკეთესო უნივერსიტეტში (Times/Sunday Times 2027): მენეჯმენტი, შემოქმედებითი წერა, მდგრადი განვითარება, კინო და სხვა, ერთ-ერთ კურსზე სრული სტიპენდიებით.
summary.ar: دورات جامعية سكنية لمدة ثلاثة أسابيع لمن تتراوح أعمارهم بين 16 و18 عاماً في أفضل جامعة بريطانية (تصنيف Times/Sunday Times 2027): الإدارة والكتابة الإبداعية والاستدامة والسينما وغيرها، مع منح كاملة لإحدى الدورات.

about.en:
The Summer Academic Experience Courses (SAEC) are the only international summer programmes at the University of St Andrews for high-school students. From 24 July to 14 August 2027, students aged 16–18 live in a university hall and take a university-style course in subjects such as Management, Economics and Entrepreneurship; Creative Writing; Sustainable Development; Cinema, Ideas and Society; and Diverse Intelligences, ending with projects such as business pitches, plus evening and weekend activities and trips.

The all-inclusive fee is GBP 6,950. Three full scholarships (tuition, accommodation and trips) are available for the Diverse Intelligences course and 10% partial scholarships (GBP 695) for Creative Writing, Sustainable Development and Cinema, Ideas and Society; scholarship applicants must show both academic merit and financial need, with a 500-word statement, by 25 February 2027.

en: Residential university experience at St Andrews for 16–18s
Small-group academic courses with projects and trips
Three full need-and-merit scholarships plus partial awards

eligibility.en: Students aged 16–18 on arrival with English at about CEFR B2 or above. All nationalities (visa may be required).

en: Choose a 2027 SAEC subject and apply via its subject page
For a scholarship, submit the 500-word statement on motivation and finances by 25 February 2027
Pay the GBP 500 deposit within 14 days of an unconditional offer
Pay the remaining GBP 6,450 by 28 April 2027

costs.en: All-inclusive fee GBP 6,950 for 2027 (see the page for exactly what it covers); travel extra. Scholarships: 3 full (Diverse Intelligences) and partial GBP 695 awards.

score_reason: Prestigious residential pre-college with a few full need-based scholarships; 2027 open now.

name.en: University of Oslo International Summer School 2027
name.ar: المدرسة الصيفية الدولية في جامعة أوسلو 2027

duration.ar: دورات من 3–4 أسابيع تبدأ 28 يونيو 2027 (النرويجية 6 أسابيع من 21 يونيو)

summary.en: Bachelor's and master's-level summer courses and Norwegian language courses in Oslo with an 80-year history; scholarships covering tuition and, optionally, housing, meals and a travel card for master's-level applicants from outside the EU/EEA.
